This market will resolve to "Raiders" if Raiders win the game.
This market will resolve to "49ers" if 49ers win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Bills and Vikings, scheduled for November 9 at 8:15PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Bills" if Bills win the game.
This market will resolve to "Vikings" if Vikings win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Commanders and Giants, scheduled for November 12 at 8:15PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Commanders" if Commanders win the game.
This market will resolve to "Giants" if Giants win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
